about: E362 AG10: the most files any shard manifest's static closure (cold boot) may pull, from scripts/gen-shards.mjs manifestClosure. One limit for every shard, not a per-shard ratchet (usage audit 2026-10-13, Jake's pick: exact counts become limits): it keeps the eager manifests near their 2026-10-13 size (largest 43) and far from the 226-273 files they pulled before E405 AG5. A manifest over it moves imports behind load / a lazy thunk.
